# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is an extremely beautiful young woman with an asymmetrical mouth, tiny, exceptionally white teeth, and brown eyes. When she married, she appeared as a delicate, ethereal fairy. She worries about her Lindsay-style nose potentially inheriting Byrne traits as time passes.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Cressida is lighthearted, playful, and charming, which wins her many admirers. Although she appears foolish and indecisive on the surface, she possesses a great deal of intellect and a sweet, loyal, and faithful nature. She admits to being chronically indecisive, though she can stand firm when it truly matters. She enjoys fun, social gatherings, and shopping, while disliking unpleasant or gloomy subjects.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c17 P2](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0002), [v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), [v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)_

## History

Cressida met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis in Wexcombe, where she quickly formed a close friendship with them and helped integrate them into college social circles. During her Freshman year, she was widely pursued by male students, constantly struggling to choose between her suitors, including Hector and Orlando. She eventually joined Nell, Honora, and Mabel in living at Tabby's Place on Linden Avenue. Despite her busy social calendar, she maintained strong academic standings and excelled in Mathematics. Over time, she fell in love with Ezra Hale and accepted his proposal of marriage, standing firm against her mother's initial disapproval. Following her graduation, she married Ezra in a June wedding with Nell serving as her bridesmaid, after which the couple planned to settle on Tanner Street.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c10 P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_
